body.statement: When \(r=1\) and \(\mathcal F_{\mathrm{causal}}(\theta)\ne\varnothing\), the sharp fiber reduces to \(\mathcal F_{\mathrm{causal}}(\theta)=\{\{j\}:Q_{jj}>0\}\).
body.justification: This reduction checks that the multivariate certificate collapses to the known rank-one changing-column ambiguity.
body.gap: The rank-one case is implicit in covariance-factor arguments, but is stated here as the required sanity reduction of the general labeled-fiber theorem.
body.consumer: Practitioners with single effective perturbations obtain a closed-form candidate list without running the recursion.
